description: This file provides utilities for interacting with the Linux /proc filesystem, including functions to retrieve container names, find process IDs by name, and send signals to processes based on regex matching.

classes.name: ProcFS
classes.description: A helper struct for interacting with the Linux /proc filesystem to retrieve container and process information.

methods.name: containerNameFromProcCgroup
methods.description: Parses cgroup content to extract the container name associated with the 'devices' cgroup.

methods.name: GetFullContainerName
methods.description: Retrieves the full container name given a process ID by reading the cgroup information.

methods.name: PKill
methods.description: Finds processes matching a regex pattern and sends a specified signal to them.

methods.name: PidOf
methods.description: Finds process IDs matching a given name pattern.

methods.name: getPids
methods.description: Internal function that scans /proc to find PIDs matching a regex pattern.
